title: Gaussian-smoothed macroscopic orbit with profiled covariance and controlled Fisher scale

smoothed_law.residual_covariance: For fixed eta small enough on the selected shell, put s_(0,k)=s_(N,k)^*-delta s_k>0 on selected modes and s_(0,k)=s_(N,k)^* elsewhere.
smoothed_law.law: Let G_N be the independent stationary diagonal Gaussian with covariance S_0 and X_N=M_N+G_N.
smoothed_law.regularity: Nondegenerate finite-dimensional Gaussian convolution gives a normalized positive smooth density with finite weighted Fisher information and all finite moments.
smoothed_law.matching: Law(X_N) is stationary and centrally symmetric with exact covariance S_N^*, so K1637's Gaussian displacement A_N^(gap) is zero and the fourth cumulant remains D_(M,N).
smoothed_law.fisher_ceiling: Fisher convexity and exact translated-Gaussian algebra give R_(Omega,N)/4<=C_(F,N):=(1/2)sum_(k in K_N) omega_k delta s_k/[s_(0,k)s_(N,k)^*].
smoothed_law.scale: Fixed-shell profile bounds, delta s_k=eta omega_k/N and d_N=Theta(N^3) give C_(F,N)=O_(g,eta)(N^4).
smoothed_law.scope_guard: The convexity ceiling is not the actual posterior-score residual. Leading negative defect plus an O(N^4) positive ceiling does not prove descent or identify the unrestricted coefficient.
